subject: Vendr portal: asset map + SIG question clarifications
messages:
From: Rachel Turner <rachel.turner@vendr.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendr portal: initial asset map request + SIG clarifications

Hi Marcus / Monica,

Thanks again for starting the Vendr portal onboarding. We pulled your Whistic profile scaffold and noticed a couple of gaps that will block the SIG import. To keep the import scoped to the CAIQ + SIG mapping, can you send: 

- A simple asset map (apps/services, owner, environment) — one-sheet XLSX is fine
- Confirmation of whether any PII is stored in S3 buckets you manage (yes/no + example buckets)
- The latest list of identity providers (IdP) in use and whether SCIM is enabled

Also, we had a couple of ambiguous SIG responses around control questions 3.4 and 6.1 — would you prefer we import as "partial" and mark for evidence, or hold off until you upload the evidence?

If it's easier, drop the asset map as an attachment in reply and we'll stage it in the portal for you. We typically try to get the basic import finished in 48-72 hours once we have the artifacts.

Thanks,
Rachel Turner
Security Onboarding Manager
Vendr

---
Note: Vendr SSO/portal: https://portal.vendr.com/onboarding

Rachel —

Appreciate the checklist. Attaching a one-sheet asset map (redwood_asset_map_q1_2027.xlsx) and a quick inventory CSV for the CAIQ import. Quick answers inline below: 

- PII in S3: partial — we store hashed customer identifiers and support logs in a single analytics bucket (redwood-logs-prod). We do not store full SSNs or payment card data in S3.
- IdPs: Okta (primary, SCIM enabled) and an emergency LDAP fallback (no SCIM).
- SIG questions 3.4 / 6.1: please mark them as "partial" and we will upload the evidence within 48 hours.

Monica — looping you in for the inventory sanity check. If you see anything missing on the asset map, please update and reply-all.

Attachments: redwood_asset_map_q1_2027.xlsx, redwood_inventory_caiq.csv

Thanks,
